# RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection
## 3 Comments
With only 58 gold-labeled studies out of 4,407, you're almost entirely dependent on your rule-based extraction for training signal. The thread on best single-model scores (735304) has a revealing pattern: every jump from 0.87 → 0.93+ came from better label extraction (mostly LLM-based), not from architecture changes.
